name: Honey×Bunny
source:
When Yoshiharu is broken hearted, his brother pushes him two rabbits. One day these rabbits turn into bunny girls. Slapstick love comedy starts with a man and two bunny girls.

[From ErogeShop.com]
translation:
义治失恋后，哥哥把两只兔子硬塞给了他。一天，这两只兔子竟变成了兔女郎。一名男子与两位兔女郎共同上演的喧闹爱情喜剧就此开幕。

[摘自ErogeShop.com]
